# 1.0.8 beta 1

This beta supersedes 1.0.7 beta 2. The numeric version increase is intentional: it lets existing
1.0.7 beta installations, including builds with the older updater, detect and install this release
through the beta channel.

- Fixed beta update checks so a newer prerelease on the same numeric core is recognized. Release
  tags are now compared using semantic-version precedence, including prerelease identifiers.
- The updater now compares the full installed version instead of only the assembly version, and
  Settings displays the complete version, such as `1.0.7-beta.2`.
- Corrected comparison of four-part assembly versions against three-part release tags.
- The stable channel continues to ignore prereleases.
- Added regression coverage for beta ordering, stable-versus-prerelease ordering, build metadata,
  and the otherwise unchanged installer, Steam and VR flows.

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
